name: Field
description: Open fields and meadows are turfed with lush, short grass and wildflowers. A near-total lack of trees grants these areas with gentle breezes, open skies, and warm sunlight. With temperate weather and moderate rainfall, many Normal- and Flying-types can be found in these habitats. Oddly, Electric-types often dwell here as well, perhaps so they can be unobstructed by trees during lightning storms.
